_comment: The graphs inside cat-harness's `integrations` sub-graph, declared FROM WITHIN (#980) on the pattern of `work-plan/graph.json`. OPT-IN (`optIn: true` on its entry): off in every layer unless that layer lists `cat-harness.integrations` in its own `enableSubgraphs` (owner, 2026-11-10, card Q-SG-1 C, wave 1).
